name: 1.5B无干预训练校准标签内容审查
purpose: 检查自校准的过度／欠思考代理标签与上下文内容是否一致；不是干预效果评测。
difference_from_previous: 首次审查已有训练校准步骤的语义内容；不再测试首步强度，不复用测试集挑规则。

protocol.sampling: uniform questions; one random step per available original stratum per question; no replacement for absent strata

rubric.new: New derivation, condition, case elimination, correction or different verification. Mathematical validity recorded separately.
rubric.repeat: Equivalent prior reasoning or conclusion without new condition, calculation or verification. Must cite an earlier step.

protocol.reviewer: Single Codex model-assisted review; no independent human gold labels
protocol.masking: Original label, confidence, match flags and final grading hidden. Review packets in numerical rounds; seal each round before reading later prefixes. Visible wording can suggest the heuristic label; not perfect blindness.
protocol.interpretation: Content audit only, not causal redundancy, underthinking ground truth, population error rate or efficacy evidence. Stratified counts must not be pooled as prevalence.
protocol.incidental_prior_exposure: Schema inspection printed calibration question 0 before sampling. No other selected answer was read before preparation.
